decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development of the site as a petrol filling station will not provide significant employment opportunities and does not contribute to the role of the Great West Road as one of London's primary 'gateways' and a key corridor of economic activity. This would be contrary to policy E.1.2 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan 1996; and policy IMP.4.2 of the Unitary Development Plan Revised Deposit Version (2001).

Condition : 2 - Renewal of permission may prejudice the future development of the site as a location of significant employment and in particular the implementation of recent planning permission for the development of the site as commercial offices.
description: Renewal of planning permission reference 00505/AY/P7 (for the demolition of existing bank and erection of filling station, shop unit and parking facilities) date 23/02/1998.
